title: Forming passive sentences (2): verb + -ing or to-infinitive
summary: Пассив внутри конструкций с инфинитивом и -ing: to be done, to have been done, being done, having been done, а также пассив при дополнении с инфинитивом (be made to, be seen to, be allowed to) и need doing.
ru:
## Пассивный инфинитив и герундий
Когда страдательный смысл нужен не в личной форме, а внутри **инфинитива** или **-ing формы**, пассив строится так:
- **to be + V3** — She hopes **to be promoted**. / The package is expected **to be delivered** tomorrow.
- **to have been + V3** (раньше) — He seems **to have been misled**.
- **being + V3** — I can't stand **being interrupted**. / She remembers **being taken** to the sea as a child.
- **having been + V3** (раньше, формально) — **Having been warned**, they stayed at home.
> Nobody likes **being criticised** in public. — Никто не любит, когда его критикуют при всех.
> I'd hate **to be misunderstood**. — Мне бы не хотелось, чтобы меня неправильно поняли.
То, что по-русски передаётся придаточным («чтобы меня…», «когда меня…»), по-английски часто даёт именно пассивный инфинитив или *being + V3*.

## После каких слов что выбирать
- **to be + V3**: want, hope, expect, deserve, intend, need, would like / love / hate / prefer, be likely, be supposed.
- **being + V3**: avoid, enjoy, mind, risk, resent, dislike, imagine, remember, can't stand, и **любой предлог**: without **being asked**, instead of **being told**, afraid of **being late**.
- **having been + V3**: deny, admit, regret, и в начале предложения: **Having been refused** twice, she gave up. После deny/admit возможно и простое being: He denies **having been** / **being** involved.

## Дополнение + инфинитив: превращаем в пассив
В активе после many verbs идёт «дополнение + инфинитив»: *They told him to wait.* В пассиве дополнение становится подлежащим, и **to-infinitive сохраняется**: *He was told to wait.* Такие глаголы: advise, allow, ask, enable, encourage, expect, force, invite, order, permit, persuade, remind, require, tell, warn.
Особые случаи — глаголы, у которых в активе голый инфинитив:
- **make**: They made him sign. → He **was made to sign** (в пассиве **to появляется**). ~~He was made sign.~~
- **let** пассива не имеет: They let us leave. → We **were allowed to leave**.
- **see, hear, watch**: She was seen **to enter** the building (завершённое) / seen **entering** (процесс).
> The workers **were made to work** overtime. — Рабочих заставили работать сверхурочно.
> He **was seen to leave** at midnight. — Видели, как он ушёл около полуночи.

## need, want, deserve + -ing
После **need, want** (британский вариант, разговорно), **require, deserve, bear** активный **-ing** имеет **пассивный смысл**: возможна и форма *to be + V3*:
> The roof **needs repairing** = The roof **needs to be repaired**.
> The idea **deserves considering** = deserves **to be considered**.
Подлежащим должна быть вещь, которую надо починить, а не исполнитель: ~~The mechanic needs repairing.~~

## Инфинитив при существительном: active или passive?
Разница в направлении действия: **something to do** (я делаю), но **something to be done** (его кто-то должен сделать). Сравните:
> I have a report **to write**. — Мне предстоит написать отчёт. (я автор)
> There is nothing **to be gained** by arguing. — От спора ничего не выиграть.
> Several questions remain **to be answered**. — Остаётся ответить на ряд вопросов.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I hate to being interrupted.~~ → I hate **being interrupted** / **to be interrupted**.
- ~~She was made leave early.~~ → She was made **to leave** early.
- ~~He was let go in.~~ (с «let» пассив невозможен) → He was **allowed to go** in.
- ~~The windows need cleaned.~~ — это шотландский/американский диалект; в нейтральном английском **need cleaning / need to be cleaned**.
en:
## Passive infinitives and -ing forms
When we need the passive inside an infinitive or an -ing form, we use:
- **to be + V3** — She hopes **to be promoted**.
- **to have been + V3** (earlier) — He seems **to have been misled**.
- **being + V3** — I can't stand **being interrupted**.
- **having been + V3** (earlier, formal) — **Having been warned**, they stayed at home.
> Nobody likes **being criticised** in public.
> I'd hate **to be misunderstood**.

## Which form after which word
- **to be + V3**: want, hope, expect, deserve, intend, need, would like / love / hate / prefer, be likely.
- **being + V3**: avoid, enjoy, mind, risk, resent, dislike, imagine, remember, can't stand, and **after any preposition**: without **being asked**, instead of **being told**, afraid of **being late**.
- **having been + V3**: deny, admit, regret, and at the start of a sentence: **Having been refused** twice, she gave up.

## Object + infinitive in the passive
Verbs such as advise, allow, ask, encourage, expect, force, invite, order, persuade, tell, warn take «object + to-infinitive». In the passive the object becomes the subject and **to stays**: *He was told to wait.*
Special cases:
- **make**: *They made him sign.* → He **was made to sign** (**to appears** in the passive).
- **let** has no passive: *We were allowed to leave.*
- **see, hear, watch**: She was seen **to enter** (complete action) / seen **entering** (in progress).

## need, want, deserve + -ing
After **need, want** (informal BrE), **require, deserve** the -ing form has a passive meaning:
> The roof **needs repairing** = The roof **needs to be repaired**.
The subject must be the thing that is repaired: ~~The mechanic needs repairing.~~

## Infinitive after a noun
**something to do** (I do it) but **something to be done** (someone else must do it): There is nothing **to be gained** by arguing. Several questions remain **to be answered**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~She was made leave early.~~ → She was made **to leave** early.
- ~~He was let go in.~~ → He was **allowed to go** in.
- ~~I hate to being interrupted.~~ → I hate **being interrupted**.
structure:
## Формулы
| Форма | Формула | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Пассивный инфинитив | to be + V3 | He wants to be told. |
| Перфектный пассивный инфинитив | to have been + V3 | She seems to have been warned. |
| Пассивный герундий | being + V3 | I resent being treated like that. |
| Перфектный пассивный герундий | having been + V3 | Having been told, he left. |
| Дополнение + инфинитив (актив) | verb + obj + to V | They told him to wait. |
| То же в пассиве | obj → subject: be + V3 + to V | He was told to wait. |

## Особые глаголы
| Актив | Пассив |
|---|---|
| They made him sign. | He was made **to** sign. |
| They let us leave. | We were **allowed to** leave. |
| I saw her enter. | She was seen **to** enter. |
| I saw her entering. | She was seen entering. |

## need / want / deserve
> need + **-ing** = need + **to be + V3**
> The car needs servicing. = The car needs to be serviced.
> deserve + to be + V3: She deserves **to be paid** more.

exercises.title: Пассивный инфинитив и -ing
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в нужную пассивную форму (to be + V3, being + V3, having been + V3).
exercises.example: She hopes (promote) soon. → She hopes **to be promoted** soon.

items.text: Nobody likes {{being criticised|being criticized}} in public.
The patient is expected {{to be discharged}} on Friday.
He left the building without {{being noticed}}.
I'd hate {{to be misunderstood}} by my colleagues.
She remembers {{being taken}} to the circus as a child.
{{Having been warned}} about the storm, they stayed at home.
The company denies {{having been involved|being involved}} in the scandal.

exercises.title: to be done, to do или being done
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужную форму глагола из скобок.

items.text: The old roof needs {{replacing|to be replaced}}.
The contract is {{to be signed}} on Monday.
She doesn't like {{being told}} what to do.
He was made {{to apologise|to apologize}} to the whole team.
They were not allowed {{to leave}} the building before midnight.
He deserves {{to be paid}} more for such work.

items.q: The suspect was seen ___ the building at midnight.
items.why: После see в пассиве голый инфинитив активной формы превращается в **to-infinitive**: was seen **to enter**.
В пассиве после make **to появляется**: were made **to work**.

items.q: I'm not used to ___ spoken to like that.
The kitchen needs ___ before we move in.
items.why: need + **-ing** имеет пассивный смысл (= needs to be painted); ~~needs to paint~~ означало бы, что кухня сама красит.

items.q: He was allowed ___ the lab only after a security check.
items.why: allow + obj + **to-infinitive**; в пассиве to сохраняется.

items.q: The refugees are reported ___ the border yesterday.
items.why: Событие произошло раньше сообщения → **to have crossed**.

items.q: She was delighted at ___ asked to speak at the conference.
I resent ___ treated like a child.
The report is believed ___ by a former employee.
items.why: Отчёт написан кем-то раньше → **to have been written**.
deserve + **to be + V3**: deserves to be judged.

items.q: We don't want the project ___ before the audit.
items.why: Проект сам не отменяет → **to be cancelled** (want + object + to be + V3).

items.q: ___ by a colleague, he finally admitted his mistake.
items.why: Его посоветовали раньше, и это пассив → **Having been advised**.

exercises.title: Перефразируйте с пассивом
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, начиная со слов в стрелке.

items.prompt: She hopes that someone will promote her. → She hopes ...
He hates it when people interrupt him. → He hates ...
They told the guests to wait outside. → The guests ...
answers: The guests were told to wait outside.

items.prompt: They made him sign the paper. → He ...
answers: He was made to sign the paper.

items.prompt: Someone saw her enter the building. → She ...
answers: She was seen to enter the building.
She was seen entering the building.

items.prompt: I don't like it when people laugh at me. → I don't like ...
answers: I don't like being laughed at.
I do not like being laughed at.

exercises.title: need doing, to be done, having been done
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, начиная со слов в стрелке.

items.prompt: The windows must be cleaned. → The windows need ...
answers: The windows need to be cleaned.

items.prompt: Someone should repair the lift. → The lift needs ...
answers: The lift needs to be repaired.

items.prompt: He was very pleased that the committee had chosen him. → He was very pleased to ...
answers: He was very pleased to have been chosen by the committee.
He was very pleased to have been chosen.

items.prompt: They didn't invite her, and she was upset about it. → She was upset about ...
answers: She was upset about not being invited.
She was upset about not having been invited.

items.prompt: We must do many things before the opening. → There are many things to be ...
answers: There are many things to be done before the opening.

items.prompt: After someone had warned him, he changed his plans. → Having ...
answers: Having been warned, he changed his plans.
Having been warned he changed his plans.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя пассивный инфинитив или being + V3.

items.prompt: Чего вы не любите? (I don't like being ...)
items.sample: I don't like being interrupted when I am working.

items.prompt: Чего вы надеетесь добиться? (I hope to be ...)
items.sample: I hope to be promoted to a senior position next year.

items.prompt: Что вам запрещали в детстве? (I was not allowed to ...)
items.sample: I was not allowed to stay out after nine o'clock.

items.prompt: К чему вас принуждали? (I was made to ...)
items.sample: At school I was made to learn long poems by heart.

items.prompt: Что дома требует ремонта или уборки? (needs ...)
О чём вы помните, что вам говорили в детстве? (I remember being ...)
items.sample: I remember being told that honesty is the best policy.
